message: You know that friend who always seems to panic at the slightest bump in the road? Well, financial preparedness is kind of like having a safety net for those unexpected twists and turns. I found a great resource that lays out some practical steps to make sure you're ready for whatever comes your way. It's all about feeling a little more secure and less like you're juggling flaming torches. How do you keep calm when life throws you a curveball?
